headline: South Korea Exports Stay Strong on AI Semiconductor Demand
summary: South Korea's export boom remains robust ahead of a central bank rate decision, supported by booming global demand for artificial intelligence and semiconductors.
why: South Korea is a key hub for global semiconductor manufacturing, making its export figures a bellwether for technology hardware demand.

impacts.name: Semiconductors
impacts.why: Sustained export growth indicates high utilization and strong pricing power for memory chips.
